name: Savel
summary: Savel showcases a matte Naqiu Green marble top with rich, natural veining that gives the piece a poised, elevated presence. The body is wrapped in light grey matte elm veneer, adding a soft contemporary texture that pairs cleanly with the stone. Inside, melamine panels keep the interior crisp and orderly. Brass metallic painted metal legs introduce a warm, polished contrast, giving the design a graceful modern balance. Top with Naqiu green marble top (matte), the body all cover with elm veneer in light grey matt inner panels with melamine, metal legs paint in brass metallic. 200x42x83
